turn.content: The evidence is clear. The only goods receipt for PO-2026-0099 (GR-2026-0099) recorded just the Stretch Film — the 2 Label Pengiriman A6 units were never received, and no earlier invoice on this PO billed them, so this isn't a resubmission or a later-delivery billing. Contract clause KTR-V-019#4.2 allows billing only for goods received and recorded.
